summary:
w198 plan written. All 11 accepted tests (supervision r75, r105, r120, r121) already pass, so nothing is red; the work is the seven retirements in the Retires section.
D0: each deprecated scenario is retired with `features retire` (with --file where needed); the generated tests go with the scenarios, and test_bound stays green.
D1: two step definitions left unused by the retirements are removed: other_initiative (supervision_integrate_steps.py, used only by the deprecated r102) and drafted (test_work_queue.py, used only by the deprecated work-queue r1). Every other step is shared with a live scenario.
No script changes; no test needs rewriting.
Open: the research defects D1-D3 (unbounded fix loop, one-string questions dropped, cut-short analysis never retried) are out of scope and are named for a follow-up.
